gaps.explanation: Re-read pp5-6, 10-21. Statement p5 (printed p9) expenditures per fund column = detail per fund: General 445,724 (p10-11 schedule total 445,724), Street 224,228 (p12), Debt Service blank, Sales Tax 6 (p15), Cemetery 22,036 (p17), Community Ambulance 469,481 (p18), Swimming Pool 111,198 (p16), Other Governmental Funds 134,290 = Park 10,976 + Library 44,931 + Library Board 77,546 + Parks and Recreation Board 837 (p21); sum 1,406,963 = printed Total expenditures. The whole difference is the Debt Service Fund: statement p6 (printed p10) prints its 'Debt principal payments - long-term debt' (180,000) and 'Debt interest payments' (56,113) under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES), while the Debt Service Fund budget schedule p14 (printed p44) prints the same money as DISBURSEMENTS: Bond retirement 180,000 (detail[71]), Interest on bonds 55,713 (detail[72]), Agent fees 400 (detail[73]), Total disbursements 236,113. 1,406,963 + 236,113 = 1,643,076 = schedule total. Each amount is in detail once; nothing is missing or counted twice; the report presents the same payments in a different section on the two pages. No change.

Statement p6 General Fund column: Debt issuance - line of credit 199,000 (= JSON debt_proceeds), Debt principal payments - line of credit (60,000), Debt interest payments (3,135); Debt Service Fund column: Debt principal payments - long-term debt (180,000), Debt interest payments (56,113). General Fund budget schedule p11 (printed p41) prints Loan (LOC) 199,000 = detail[36], Loan - payment (60,000) = detail[37], Loan - interest (3,135) = detail[38]. Non-transfer other-financing detail = 199,000 - 60,000 - 3,135 = 135,865; the 63,135 gap to debt_proceeds is the printed LOC repayment and interest, which the JSON statement side holds in other_financing (-299,248 = -60,000 - 180,000 - 59,248). Against debt_proceeds + other_financing (-100,248) the remaining difference is the Debt Service Fund 236,113 that detail holds as disbursements from schedule p14 (see expenditure row). No printed line missing; adding 180,000 / 56,113 as other financing would count them twice. No change.
